verdict.rationale: Supabase branching creates separate environments, including per-PR preview environments, for testing schema changes without touching production. Its official MCP server gives agents `apply_migration` plus branching tools (`create_branch`, `merge_branch`, `reset_branch`, `rebase_branch`), and the docs recommend branching so agents can test changes safely before merging. A local CLI stack with an MCP endpoint offers a second isolated option. Missing for 10: the MCP branching tools are labeled experimental, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of an agent-driven branch-test-merge workflow.
